d: Long, straight midnight-blue hair with blunt bangs and a slight side-part frames a youthful, adolescent face with sharp, focused light-blue eyes. The slender build is dressed in a white short-sleeved button-up shirt with a grey tie and trim, a dark grey pleated mini-skirt, one black sleeve on the right arm, and dark grey thigh-high stockings. Heavy olive-drab metallic naval artillery gear is worn as a backpack, featuring a large gun turret and several smaller cannon barrels.
